articles.title: IN BRIEF: Putin's meeting on Konstantinovka liberation, special military operation course
articles.summary: Putin held a meeting at a command post where he was briefed on the liberation of Konstantinovka and Russian military progress, calling the city's capture key to liberating the entire Donetsk People's Republic.

articles.title: Russia's buffer zone on Ukrainian border evolves as military advances — Kremlin
articles.summary: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov stated that Russia is systematically creating a security buffer zone on the Ukrainian border as a response to the Kiev regime's aggressive nature.

articles.title: Russian army increases advance pace in DPR in June — military expert
articles.summary: Military expert reported that Russian forces increased their advance pace in the Donetsk People's Republic in June, with Putin announcing on June 28 that Russian forces controlled 96% of Konstantinovka.

articles.title: Kremlin delivers remarks on Putin-Lukashenko talks, Ukraine dialogue channels
articles.summary: Kremlin spokesman confirmed that Russia's position on Ukraine, outlined by Putin at the Russian Foreign Ministry two years ago, remains unchanged and discussed recent talks between Putin and Belarusian leader Lukashenko.
